devon_support: FYI customer reports consistent 250-400ms added latency today. They say traffic is routing to EU while they9re US-based :confused:

maria_ops: any quick indicators on why region selection flipped?

devon_support: digging through headers from the SDK. noticed a pattern: the SDK is sending `region=auto` as a query param and `X-Client-Region:` (empty string) as a header in the same request. gateway picks up empty header and falls back to EU edge for some routes.

ingrid_platform: can you paste an example request?

devon_support: sure — from their repro (redacted):
```
GET /v1/generate?region=auto HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Client-Region: 
User-Agent: acme-sdk/1.2.3
```

devon_support: server logs show fallback: `route_selected=eu-west-1 ; reason=header_precedence && header_value==""`

maria_ops: aha — header precedence logic treats presence of header (even empty) as higher priority than query param. If header present but empty, it prefers header and ends up using default-region mapping -> EU.

sre-bot: [automated] Routing anomaly detected: 1200 requests in last 30m where `X-Client-Region` present but empty. 92% originated from acme's token.

ingrid_platform: steps to repro locally?

devon_support: 1) curl example: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Region:" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=us-east-1" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
You9ll see the request land in eu-west if header exists even though `region` param says us-east-1.

maria_ops: wow. SDK bug then — sending an empty header instead of omitting it when region=auto. Which SDK version?

devon_support: acme uses Node SDK 1.2.3 and Python 0.9.8 (both had the same defaulting behaviour).

ingrid_platform: immediate mitigation: update gateway to treat empty header as absent (i.e., ignore header if trimmed value == ""). That will restore query-param fallback. Also add logging metric for empty-region headers.

maria_ops: agree. quick fix on gateway side is low-risk. then we should patch SDKs to stop sending empty header. Proposed plan:
- PATCH gateway to ignore empty X-Client-Region (canary 30% traffic) — ETA 2h
- Publish SDK patch to 1.2.4 / 0.9.9 to stop sending empty header — ETA 1 day
- Notify affected customers and include repro/mitigation steps

devon_support: I9ll open the escalation ticket and ping customers. Adding suggested curl snippet for interim: set explicit header to `us-east-1` or remove header entirely.

ingrid_platform: add unit test in routing precedence: header presence with empty value should not override query param. Also add integration test for SDK defaulting.

maria_ops: thanks. tagging @ingrid for follow-up. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: [automated] Canary rollout scheduled: gateway config change -> ignore-empty-region header. 30% traffic for 1hr.
summary: SDKs sending empty X-Client-Region headers caused routing precedence to fall back to EU edges; plan: gateway ignore-empty-header patch + SDK fixes and customer comms
